calls.title: Teresa / Johnny - Features Tables Sync
calls.summary: The team discussed design refinements aimed at enhancing UI consistency and user experience across different modes. Key changes included replacing the yellow border color with gray for tables to unify the design, switching tooltip themes to white in dark mode to align with standard expectations, and revising pagination button colors for clarity. Efforts also targeted table responsiveness by limiting visible tags to one and ensuring proper sizing of components. Additionally, a new lightweight table component was planned, promoting modular development and integration. The meeting highlighted the cautious adoption of AI tools in design, emphasizing the need for human oversight to maintain unique designs alongside efficiency gains.
calls.keywords: feature tables, dark mode, UI colors, tooltip theme, pagination, information tables
